changelog: Improved raycast detection with synchronous probing and proximity resolution for static GTA map props.
Added complete hidden objects export to structured JSON (data/export_hidden_objects.json).
Added standalone ready-to-run FiveM Lua script export (data/export_hidden_objects.lua).
Added single-zone and full-database export buttons in creator menus.
Added 3D Freecam mode for polygon creation with Left-Click placing and live height adjustments.
